title: Cinematic title
caption: The cinematic-title recipe: a letterboxed, glowing title card with a lens-flare streak and wide uppercase tracking, for openers and film-style title moments.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6-second 16:9 title card for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the cinematic-title style. The title is "Magnifito" with the approved service line "Websites, social media, email, ads and automation" under it (claim-services in claims.json). Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.
